saw_lines: Coffee buyers stick to one blend for months and switch only when the bag runs out or the cup tastes off.
So the sale is won or lost at the second bag, when buyers decide whether to reorder or try another roaster.
Your 34 Google creatives, 23 of them text, date from Aug 2022, so rewrite the opening line of every text ad around one product like Classico or Degustationsbox.
